arguments.query:
SELECT time, host, sld, method, url, status_code, headers
FROM browser_history
WHERE time <= '2022-07-16 15:03:36'
  AND time >= '2022-07-16 00:00:00'
  AND (
    lower(coalesce(host,'')) LIKE '%discord%'
    OR lower(coalesce(sld,'')) LIKE '%discord%'
    OR lower(coalesce(url,'')) LIKE '%discord%'
    OR lower(coalesce(headers,'')) LIKE '%discord%'
    OR lower(coalesce(url,'')) LIKE '%discordsetup.exe%'
    OR lower(coalesce(headers,'')) LIKE '%discordsetup.exe%'
  )
ORDER BY time ASC
LIMIT 30;

ORDER BY time ASC
